guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at the step of running 'apt-get update' and installing system packages, reporting 404 errors on Ubuntu lunar (23.04) repositories: 'http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu lunar-security Release' and 'http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu lunar Release' not found. This indicates the repository URLs for Ubuntu 23.04 (Lunar Lobster) are unavailable or obsolete in the base image. To fix this, consider using a supported and stable Ubuntu version such as 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish) instead of 23.04 in the FROM statement, which has stable repository URLs. Alternatively, check and update to correct repository mirrors or adjust sources.list appropriately if 23.04 must be used. Fixing the base image or repository URLs will resolve the build failure.
